recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片中，散布大量帶粗大橘紅色顆粒的嗜酸性球，其中不少是細胞核圓形、顆粒偏紫紅的嗜酸性骨髓細胞（eosinophilic myelocytes），可判斷為嗜酸性球增多。
features: Markedly increased eosinophils and eosinophilic precursors scattered throughout the field
Coarse refractile orange-red granules filling the cytoplasm of mature eosinophils
Eosinophilic myelocytes/metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and admixed purplish (basophilic-staining) immature granules
Hypercellular aspirate with background neutrophilic precursors, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
No obvious increase in blasts or clustered atypical cells at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular. There is a striking increase in eosinophils at all stages of maturation, including numerous eosinophilic myelocytes and metamyelocytes with coarse orange-red granules, some with admixed immature purple granules. The background contains maturing neutrophilic and erythroid precursors without an apparent increase in blasts at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow eosinophilia; correlation with peripheral eosinophil count, clinical history (parasites, drugs, allergy) and, if persistent, cytogenetic/molecular studies (PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1, JAK2 rearrangements, CBFB::MYH11) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows increased myeloblasts/monoblasts with abnormal eosinophils bearing large dark basophilic granules, whereas this field shows orderly eosinophil maturation without a visible blast excess.

May look morphologically similar with maturing eosinophils and often increased atypical mast cells, so FIP1L1::PDGFRA testing rather than morphology is needed to separate it from reactive eosinophilia.
Features spindled mast cells with metachromatic granules and CD25/CD117 positive aggregates, which are not seen in this aspirate field.
